source_evidence: Exact player 'I hope I prove to be an effective and fair leader. But I must warn you, I am also fast to remove obstacles.' V expresses leadership aspiration and warns Ysendre of his decisive nature; no specific threat, command, demand for concession, attack, or oath. Ysendre acknowledges the importance of strength alongside fairness, responds with restrained amusement and says she endeavors not to become an obstacle; she asks that V allow her to explain herself if they disagree. Fenar amused, reinforces V's warning in her own speech; Cirren/Mara remain observant. Caul understands the warning as evidence that the claimant expects results and will act against obstruction; her existing independent motives and boundaries remain intact, no compelled obedience, new promise, surrendered authority or changed trial terms. She proposes that V consider allowing the evening's agreements to stand and judge her by her subsequent conduct, with no obligation for V to depart or rest. No check required for voluntary reaction to a general warning absent a concrete contested demand. Day334~20:36. No expenditure, combat, movement, rest, new messenger, title transfer, captive release confirmation or resource changes. V chooses next response.
